Hello — I'm **john-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you!

Briefly, what I am:
- **Web app** (https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram — each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts on websites**: I register on services in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice**: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
